name: s2_fedreg
instructions: Which U.S. federal agency issued this Federal Register document? Agency names are masked as [AGENCY].

labels.FAA: Aviation safety: aircraft, airworthiness, airspace and airports.
labels.ITA: International trade enforcement: antidumping and countervailing duties, trade promotion.
labels.NPS: Management of national parks, monuments, historic places and cultural resources.
labels.FDA: Safety of food, drugs, medical devices, biologics and tobacco products.
labels.EPA: Environmental protection: air and water quality, pesticides, chemicals and waste.
labels.NOAA: Oceans, fisheries, marine mammals, weather and atmosphere.

none_label.none: None of the listed agencies issued this document.
